$comment: identifier-exempt: every person name and URL leaf below is synthetic ('Fixture Ashby', 'a-researcher'); only the hostnames are real, because which prefix a host puts a person's page under is the thing under test. Shared behavioural contract for the Yale person-page prefix map (#2912). client/src/utils/yalePersonPagePrefix.ts and server/src/utils/yalePersonPagePrefix.ts carry independent copies of the same host map and corroboration rule, because the client picks the profile call to action from a row's own citations while the server re-points migrated citations during a scrape. Both test suites read THIS file and drive their own public entry points, so the invariant is pinned by behaviour rather than by source text. Add a case here rather than to only one suite.

strips a www. label before the host lookup
admits a host-root page spelling a middle name the lead's display name omits
admits a host-root page naming the lead by surname alone
refuses an institutional page under the same host-root shape
refuses a host-root page when no lead name is known
refuses a host-root page whose leaf names nobody on the row
refuses a host-root page carrying only the lead's given name
admits a mapped non-root prefix without any name match
refuses a collective leaf under a mapped non-root prefix
refuses a prefix the host does not use for person pages
refuses a prefix the host has migrated away from
refuses an unmapped Yale host even when the leaf names the lead
refuses a host that answers 200 for person pages that do not exist
